_comment: Slither configuration for the mvp-launch branch (15 MVP contracts). Matches foundry.toml so static analysis sees the same compilation as forge. Auditor handoff config — sanitized for the post-MVP-cut scope.
_compilation: Slither uses crytic-compile under the hood; pointing at this contracts/ subdir picks up foundry.toml automatically (solc 0.8.26, via_ir=true, optimizer_runs=200, evm_version=cancun, code_size_limit=24576).
_scope: mvp-launch includes only these 15 contracts under src/: Toweli, TegridyFactory, TegridyPair, TegridyRouter, TegridyTWAP, TegridyStaking, TegridyStakingJbacVault, TegridyStakingAdmin, TegridyRestaking, RevenueDistributor, ReferralSplitter, SwapFeeRouter, SwapFeeRouterAdmin, POLAccumulator, TegridyTokenURIReader. Plus base/PauseGuardian, OwnableNoRenounce, TimelockAdmin. Plus lib/SequencerCheck, lib/WETHFallbackLib, lib/VotePowerOracle. Lending, NFTLending, NFTPool, Gauges, VoteIncentives, Drop, Launchpad, FeeHook, LPFarming, CommunityGrants, MemeBountyBoard, PremiumAccess have been moved off this branch and are NOT in scope.

_detectors_excluded_rationale.naming-convention: False positives on UPPERCASE constants and underscore-prefixed internals; review-time check
_detectors_excluded_rationale.solc-version: Pinned to 0.8.26 in foundry.toml, single-version project
_detectors_excluded_rationale.low-level-calls: Used intentionally for ETH transfers via WETHFallbackLib + 10k stipend pattern (Seaport-style fail-closed)
_detectors_excluded_rationale.assembly: Used by OpenZeppelin and Solady internals; reviewed explicitly
_detectors_excluded_rationale.similar-names: False positive heavy on (token0, token1), (reserve0, reserve1) in UniswapV2 fork
_detectors_excluded_rationale.too-many-digits: Constants like 10000 BPS and 1e18 are intentional and documented
_detectors_excluded_rationale.constable-states: Several constants are timelock-tunable governance params, intentionally non-const
_detectors_excluded_rationale.dead-code: Some helpers retained for ABI compatibility and future-use carve-outs
_detectors_excluded_rationale.timestamp: LOW-only, non-gating. Every flagged block.timestamp comparison on this protocol is an intentional, period-scale time gate (timelock intervals, grace/forfeiture/cooldown windows, TWAP staleness bounds) — immune to a miner's ~12s wiggle. Pure review-noise (verified FPs across RevenueDistributor / ReferralSplitter / POLAccumulator / TegridyStaking / TegridyRestaking / TegridyTWAP, 2026-05-31). weak-prng STAYS enabled below to still catch the genuinely-dangerous timestamp-as-randomness case.

_schema_note: Slither config expects detectors_to_run and detectors_to_exclude as comma-separated strings (it calls .split(',') on them). The fail_high/fail_medium/etc keys are NOT valid config keys — severity gating happens via the exclude_* booleans above + CI grepping the JSON output.
_detectors_promoted: Fund-loss detector class. Run loud — i.e. run these IN ADDITION to everything else, and run them even if an exclusion above would have dropped them.
_detectors_promoted_key_fix: This list was under `detectors_to_run`, which does the OPPOSITE of the line above. In slither's choose_detectors, `detectors_to_run != "all"` means 'run ONLY these' and RETURNS EARLY — skipping the exclude_* severity filters and detectors_to_exclude entirely. So the config that reads 'run loud' silently disabled every detector NOT on this list, including Medium/High ones absent from it (divide-before-multiply, unchecked-transfer, unchecked-lowlevel, write-after-write). It never bit because nothing loaded this file. The moment CI did load it, `fail-on: medium` would have been gating on a gutted detector set. `detectors_to_include` is the key that means what the sentence above says: it is applied AFTER the exclusions and adds these back.
_severity_floor: Audit handoff: surface low+ for review. CI severity gate is enforced by jq-grepping the JSON output for impact==High|Medium (see .github/workflows/contracts-ci.yml — Slither step TBD).
